app.name: Sentinel
app.tagline: Your AI email assistant. Nothing is sent without your confirmation.

failure.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

auth.needs_reauth: This account needs to be reconnected.
auth.invalid_credentials: The username or password was not accepted.
auth.admin_consent_required: Your organisation requires an administrator to approve Sentinel before you can connect this account.
auth.consent_required: More permission is needed. Reconnect the account to grant it.

provider.resync: Your mailbox changed on the server, so Sentinel is syncing it again.
provider.unavailable: The mail provider is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
provider.generic: The mail provider returned an error.

ai.refusal: The AI declined to answer this one. Nothing was changed.
ai.truncated: The AI response was cut off. Try again.
ai.empty: The AI returned nothing. Try again.
ai.invalid: The AI response could not be used. Try again.

failure.ai_consent: Turn on AI processing for this account in AI settings first.

cap.cost: The monthly AI cost limit has been reached.
cap.tokens: The monthly AI token limit has been reached.

failure.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait {seconds} seconds.
failure.storage: Your data could not be saved. Try again.

validation.limit_reached: You have reached the maximum number of connected accounts.
validation.private_address: That server address is not allowed.
validation.tls_failed: A secure connection to the server could not be made. Check the security setting and port.
validation.unknown_folder: One of the selected folders does not exist.

failure.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.

send.expired: The confirmation expired. Review and confirm again.
send.content_changed: The message changed after you confirmed it. Review and confirm again.
send.placeholders: Replace the placeholders in the message first.
send.daily_limit: The daily sending limit has been reached.

accounts.title: Mail accounts
accounts.aiExcluded: Never send this account's mail to AI

connectError.denied: Access was not granted, so nothing was connected.
connectError.expired: The sign-in took too long. Please try again.
connectError.bad_state: The sign-in could not be verified. Please try again.
connectError.scope_missing: Sentinel needs permission to read mail and save drafts. Please allow all requested permissions.
connectError.no_refresh_token: The provider did not allow ongoing access. Remove Sentinel from your account's connected apps and try again.
connectError.generic: The account could not be connected.

adminHelp.title: Your organisation must approve Sentinel
adminHelp.step1: Send your IT administrator the link to this app and ask them to approve it for your organisation.
adminHelp.step2: They can grant consent in the Microsoft Entra admin centre under Enterprise applications.
adminHelp.step3: Once approved, come back here and connect again.

imap.title: Connect an IMAP account
imap.appPassword: This provider needs an app-specific password. Create one in your account's security settings and use it here.

folders.title: Folders to process
folders.hint: Sentinel only reads the folders you tick.

empty.all: No mail yet. Connect an account in Settings.

inbox.offline: You are offline. Showing what was loaded earlier.
inbox.shortcuts: Shortcuts: j / k move, Enter opens, / searches.

message.imagesBlocked: Remote images are blocked to protect your privacy.
message.attachmentsNote: Attachments are not downloaded by Sentinel. Open them in your mail app.

risk.ip_host: The address is a raw IP address.
risk.user_info: The link contains a username or password.
risk.unusual_port: The link uses an unusual port.
risk.text_mismatch: The link text says {host}, but it goes somewhere else.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.intro: Sentinel only sends mail to an AI provider after you review and allow it. Keys are stored encrypted on the server and are never shown again.

providers.name: Display name
providers.baseUrlHint: Must be https and publicly reachable.
providers.keyHint: Stored encrypted. You can replace it later but never read it back.
providers.empty: No AI provider yet. Add one to turn on summaries and drafts.

consent.title: Allow {name} to read your mail?
consent.where: If you allow this, Sentinel sends mail content to {host} so it can summarise and prioritise your mail and write draft replies.
consent.sent1: Sender, recipients, date, subject and the new text of each message (quoted history and signatures are removed).
consent.sent2: Names of attachments, never the files themselves.
consent.sent3: Your name, role, time zone and VIP senders so the AI can judge what matters.
consent.not1: Card numbers, IBANs, phone numbers and other people's email addresses are replaced before sending (you can change this in Privacy settings).
consent.not2: Mail from accounts you excluded from AI.
consent.not3: Anything at all before you allow it, and anything after you revoke.
consent.control: AI never sends email. Every reply stays a draft until you confirm it yourself.

routes.title: Task routes
routes.intro: Choose which provider and model handle each job. If the first fails, the next one is tried. Changes apply to the next request.

hint.default: Used when a job has no route of its own.
hint.triage: Runs on every new message. A small, fast model is usually enough.
hint.draft: Runs when you ask for a draft.
hint.repair: Runs only when an answer was malformed.

usage.title: Usage
usage.costCap: Cost limit per day in USD (0 = none)
usage.capHint: When a limit is reached, AI processing pauses until the next UTC day. Mail keeps syncing.
usage.priceHint: Sentinel ships no price list. Enter the prices from your provider to see costs.

bench.title: Test bench
bench.intro: Compares two models on three made-up emails. Your real mail is never used. Each run is a normal AI call: it needs consent for the provider and counts toward your usage and limits.

card.title: AI summary
card.mistakes: AI can make mistakes. Check important details.
card.byRule: Sorted by a rule, not by AI.
card.remember: Your choice is remembered for this sender.

senders.title: Important and muted senders
senders.intro: Important (VIP) senders are always treated as high importance. Muted senders are filed as low importance and never sent to AI.

actions.empty: No action items. When mail asks you to do something, it shows up here.

profile.title: Writing profile
profile.intro: This helps the AI write like you. Only these details are shared with your AI provider, and only after you have allowed it.
profile.name: Your name
profile.signatureHint: Added to the end of drafts by Sentinel, never written by the AI.

composer.intent: What do you want to say?
composer.checkHint: Highlighted parts were not in the conversation or still need your input.
composer.neverSends: Nothing is sent from here. You review and confirm every message yourself.
composer.openManually: Open the Drafts folder in your mail app to finish and send it.

send.title: Send this email?
send.subject: Subject
send.scrollToEnd: Scroll to the end of the message to enable sending.
send.newRecipients: These people were not on the conversation: {list}
send.foreign: Details that were not in the conversation: {list}
send.override: I know there are placeholders and want to send anyway.
send.undoNote: After you press Send you have a few seconds to undo.

state.failed: Not sent: the mail provider refused it. Your draft is still saved.
state.unknown: The result is uncertain. Check your Sent folder before sending again.
state.expired: Not sent: the confirmation expired or your session ended. Review and send again.
state.unknown_ref: This send is no longer tracked.

sending.title: Sending
sending.intro: Sentinel never sends on its own. Every message goes out only after you review it and press Send.
sending.undoHint: 0 to 30. The message waits this long on the server after you press Send.
sending.stepUp: Ask me to confirm my identity before sending (two-factor code, or password)
sending.placeholders: Block sending while the text still has [placeholders]
sending.external: Warn me about recipients outside my organisation
sending.logHint: Only when, from which account, how many recipients and the result. Message text is never kept.

push.title: Notifications on this device

state.unconfigured: The server has no notification keys set up, so notifications are not available.
state.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then come back.
state.off: Notifications are off on this device.
state.on: Notifications are on for this device.

push.privacy: Notifications never include the text of an email, only that something new arrived. Their only actions are Open and Mark done.

brief.title: Brief
brief.stale: This brief is from {when}. Refresh for the latest.
brief.emptyBody: Sentinel writes a short summary of what needs you. Generate your first one now.
brief.aiNote: Written by AI from your mail summaries. Check the linked mail before acting.

catch.title: Catch me up
catch.intro: Summarise any recent period. The result is shown here and is not saved.
catch.invalid: Choose a start that is before the end, within the last 90 days.

bg.title: Background checks
bg.limits: A server checks your mail for you, so Sentinel works even when this page is closed. Notifications reach browsers that allowed them.
bg.ai: Sort mail with AI in the background
bg.aiHint: Uses your AI provider while you are away. Counts toward your daily caps.

modes.needs_reply: Important mail and mail that needs a reply

bg.previewsHint: Off by default: notifications do not carry sender or subject text.
bg.quietHint: Mail that arrives during quiet hours is announced afterwards.
bg.briefNotify: Tell me when the brief is ready

signup.title: Create your account
signup.passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters. A long phrase is better than a clever one.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.hint: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.

onboarding.resume: Pick up where you left off.

welcome.title: Welcome to Sentinel
welcome.body: Sentinel reads your mail, sorts what matters, writes a short daily brief and drafts replies for you to review. It takes about two minutes to set up, and you can skip any step.

privacy.title: You stay in control
privacy.p1: Sentinel never sends an email without showing you the exact message and waiting for your confirmation.
privacy.p2: The AI sees only what it needs, with card numbers and similar details removed. Your provider keys are stored encrypted.
privacy.p3: You choose the AI provider, can exclude any account from AI, and can delete your data at any time.

accounts.title: Connect your email
accounts.body: Connect Gmail, Outlook or any IMAP mailbox. Sentinel asks only for what it needs and never gets your send permission without your confirmation.

ai.title: Choose your AI
ai.body: Sentinel works with the AI provider you choose. Add one and review what it may see before turning on summaries.
ai.ready: An AI provider is set up.
ai.none: No AI provider yet. You can add one later.
ai.consent: Review what the AI may see

brief.title: Your daily brief
brief.body: Pick when your brief is written and whether to be told when it is ready.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.scopeHint: Applies to the next thing the AI does. Replies always use the conversation you are answering.
privacy.scopeBody: Subject and the start of the message
privacy.maxChars: Most characters of a message sent to the AI
privacy.redact: Remove before sending to the AI
privacy.redactHint: These are replaced by a placeholder in what the AI receives.
privacy.exclude: Keep accounts away from the AI
privacy.excludeHint: Mail from these accounts is never sent to the AI. It is still shown and searchable.
privacy.retentionHint: Older copies are deleted from Sentinel only. Your mailbox is not touched. Mail with an open task is kept.

cache.title: Cached mail
cache.hint: Delete the copies of mail stored here. Sentinel fetches it again on the next check.

export.title: Export your data
export.hint: Download your settings, summaries, drafts and history as a ZIP file. Secrets are not included.

privacy.stepUp: Enter a code from your authenticator app to continue.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.hint: Permanently deletes your Sentinel account and everything stored for it, and disconnects your mail accounts. This cannot be undone.

message.failed: That did not work. Try again.

profile.title: Profile and writing style
profile.hint: Your name, time zone, role, sign-off and signature.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.hint: Choose providers, models and what the AI may see.

sending.title: Sending
sending.hint: Undo time, confirmation and your send history.

background.title: Background checks and notifications
background.hint: How often mail is checked, what notifies you, and the daily brief.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.hint: What the AI reads, how long mail is kept, export and delete.

security.title: Security
security.hint: Password, two-step verification, signed-in browsers and security events.

password.title: Change password
password.hint: Other devices are signed out when you change it.
password.done: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.off: Add a second step to signing in and to sensitive actions.
mfa.scan: Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
mfa.on: Two-step verification is on. Recovery codes left: {n}.
mfa.needCode: Code from your app, or a recovery code
mfa.saveCodes: Save these recovery codes now. Each works once and they are not shown again.

offline.banner: You are offline. You can read what was already loaded; opening new mail and sending need a connection.
